authoredFrom: PS2 — every relationship carries the line of the node that BEARS ITS NAME, and that line is part of the edge's identity (bash BD1 adopted; M59 #825 line contract, M60 #921 name-line rule). Authored 2026-09-26. MEASURED pre-wave, not reasoned: 0 of 3,410 relationships on the production draw of powershell@91ce9844 carried a `line_number`, and the graph surface rendered `"callSite": {"file": "Deploy.ps1", "line": null}` as if it knew a position. The two traps here are the WRAPPED declaration (a `contains` edge stamped with the declaration node's start line names a line the member's name is not written on) and MULTI-SITE (one callee, three call sites, and a dedupe key without the line keeps only the first). Each is pinned twice: as the correct claim, and as the pre-fix shape in forbidRelationships.
